_about: Stage-wide gaps: state fields the stage never models. One reason each, shared by every golden trace. A trace lists only its own exceptions in stage_ignores. Guards: mcp/tests/test_golden_traces.py.

ignores.why: The stage has no MC link, so it has no match phase; it is armed and spawned by its own buttons.
The stage keeps no death count (MC and the HUD read the engine's); `alive` is compared instead.
The stage has no HUD moment slot to expose as state (its `_moment` is an internal gate); the HUD reads the engine's.
The stage keeps no match shot count: it is the death screen's and MC's stat (engine.js `shots`), and no gun write reads it.
The ammo gauge's shot-ready cue is HUD display only (test_stage_mirror.py KNOWN_UNMIRRORED `shotCooldown`); the stage draws no gauge.
The OVERHEAT word is HUD display only (KNOWN_UNMIRRORED `am.overheatOnHud`); `heat.heat` and `heat.overheating`, the mechanic, are still compared.
The heat bar's has-heated flag is HUD display only (KNOWN_UNMIRRORED `am.heatedEver`); `heat.heat` and `heat.overheating` are still compared.
